name: testnet
notes: Testnet plan, filled in on 2026-09-16 from values verified against BSC testnet (chain 97). One 1-of-1 Safe created by contracts/script/TestnetSafe.s.sol holds owner, treasury and seed. Feed and coordinator facts were read from the live chain with cast the same day; the p99.9 feed interval comes from scripts/observe_feed.ts over 14 days. Extended on 2026-09-17 (ADR 038) with a second asset: the chain 97 faucet USDT token 0x337610d27c682e347c9cd60bd4b3b107c9d34ddd, so the ERC-20 path (approve, deposit, the Vault's exact-receipt and exact-debit checks, withdraw and the zero-reset allowance handling) is rehearsed on a real chain before mainnet. Its identity, issuer review, mint authority, feed and zero-reset behaviour were read off chain 97 with cast on 2026-09-17 and its feed interval measured with scripts/observe_feed.ts over 14 days; the evidence and what is still missing are in config/assets/97/usdt.json. This token is a faucet test token, not Binance-Peg USDT, and is never admissible on mainnet. The BNB entry is unchanged. Adding this pool to the deployment that is already live is not a Configure run: see the runbook section "Adding the USDT pool".

maxRequestCostDerivation.note: 50 gwei lane (s_provingKeys maxGas = 50000000000 on the coordinator, 2026-09-16) x (300000 callback + 200000 max verification gas from docs.chain.link/vrf/v2-5/billing) x 1.60 (s_config nativePremiumPercentage = 60, fulfillmentFlatFeeNativePPM = 0, read from the coordinator 2026-09-16) = 0.04 BNB.

ownership.note: Testnet: one 1-of-1 Safe (v1.4.1, owner = the deployer keystore account) holds all three roles. No make-whole reserve on testnet; there is none, and this says so plainly. SPEC section 12.1 allows one operator Safe for owner, treasury and seed on testnet; mainnet requires three separate Safes with 2-of-3 hardware keys (SPEC section 10.5). The final owner must accept both Ownable2Step transfers, and the seed account must call Vault.authorizeSeed itself before any seed entry.

assets.name: BNB
assets.exactTransferEvidence: Native path: the Vault credits exactly msg.value and checks the exact debit on withdrawal, so no token transfer hook can change the amount (SPEC section 3.1).

pool.notes: 5 USDT seed with a 10 USDT per-round cap, the same 2x seed-to-cap ratio as the BNB entry. SPEC section 5.4 asks for a seed well above USD 1: in a USDT pool the conversion is exact by construction, so 5 USDT is USD 5 at the reference price, well above the USD 1 minimum and still a twentieth of the smallest USD 100 daily target. The BNB seed of 0.001 BNB is worth well under USD 1 and is left as it is, because testnet money makes that harmless; this figure applies the section 5.4 floor rather than copying it, matching the intent recorded for mainnet in config/assets/56/usdt.json. The seed account must still call Vault.authorizeSeed(asset, cap) itself for this asset, and must hold a USDT balance in the Vault: pointing is not consent and consent does not cross assets.
